about: Hand labels of the FIRST drafts of the Copilot 3.3 VALIDATION split (eval/copilot33_answers_baseline32.json, collected live from the deployed 3.2 pipeline on 2026-10-17). Same protocol and single annotator as copilot33_labels_dev.json; written before any detector was run on these answers.
